# Small samples need a notebook of exclusions

An interview study does not become rigorous by borrowing a statistical phrase. The harbour archive speakers were selected through people the curator already knows. Record who declined, who couldn't travel and whose work hours conflict with ours. The eventual exhibition should acknowledge that these are available voices, not the harbour speaking with one voice. [[Field methods]] needs an exclusions log.
